job.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI-Native Platform
job.description: Lansweeper is evolving its engineering organization toward an AI-native development model. We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to build reliable, scalable systems while operating in an AI-augmented development environment. In the near term, you will contribute to the Redjack integration team, ensuring system quality, architectural clarity, and scalable design as multiple AI-assisted development streams run in parallel. Longer term, you will help shape how AI-native engineering practices scale across the platform.
responsibilities: Design and build maintainable, scalable, observable, and well-tested software systems
Operate in an AI-augmented development workflow, decomposing problems and validating AI-generated outputs
Contribute to architecture discussions, long-term system evolution, and technical direction
Apply strong system thinking across data models, APIs, distributed systems, and service boundaries
Produce clear technical documentation, structured prompts, and design proposals
Mentor peers and collaborate with Product, UX, and Engineering teams
